_source: Supplier issues raised by Subrato, 06-Aug-2026. #1 Parent Supplier Name and #3 Supplier Site are implemented here; #2 (taxpayer id by country) is deliberately NOT implemented — no supplier source carries the per-country tax columns it named, so it would only ship blanks.
_scope: Client NextPower, supplier source systems (NetSuite tracker, All-Vendors Phoenix, eBOS). Each rule is scoped to the Supplier interface object it belongs to.
_precedence: One dated store. These entries carry effective_date 2026-08-06, so they beat earlier statements about the same field and lose to anything said later — including an analyst's own edit.

rules.note: Supplier issue #1: 'Parent Supplier Name to fetch and display the legal_name associated with the parent supplier id.' A self-join within the supplier extract: this row's Parent Vendor Id identifies another vendor by Internal ID, and that vendor's Legal Name is the parent name. SELF_LOOKUP builds the Internal ID->Legal Name index once per generation. Was mapped to the raw Parent Vendor Id; this replaces the id with the name.

Supplier issue #3: 'Format the Supplier Site string using the convention BU(country code)-CITY.' BU is a lookup on the country code, so country_map holds the country-code -> BU pairs (e.g. {"US":"US-PROC","CA":"CA-PROC"}); a code not in the map ships unchanged. country_map is EMPTY pending the analyst's BU mapping — until it is filled this behaves exactly like the existing country-code + city key, which is safe.
